'''District''' is a 4on4 TDM map by {{player|alice|flag=se}}. The map aim to have a minimal look with clean and simplified textures, as well trying to have a layout without unnecessary details. The plain texture set is supposed to assist with easy navigation, where [[Red Armor]] and [[Yellow Armor]] areas are distinctly colorized red and yellow. The overall layout of the map consist of 2 opposing sides with an open "street" inbetween the sides, each side hold a key armor and a [[Rocket Launcher]]. Beneath this central street there is a "sewer" path where [[Lightning Gun]] is placed. The map offer plenty of vertical layout where it has as much as 4 height levels in the center area
